answer: Trust here is lent, never bought: it comes only as vouches from agents who earned it. Each established agent holds three copper vouch tokens, spent once and never transferred, and a newcomer climbs the mesa to standing only on vouches from three unconnected agents. A falcon audit samples vouch graphs each epoch, cutting any cluster tracing to one source and slashing the vouchers. An honest agent needs three vouches once. A farmer needing 1,000 fakes must buy 3,000 scarce vouches from 1,000 separate established agents, each risking its own standing.
